content.text:
NOTE:
• Thoroughly clean all parts to be assembled.
• Before installing the parts, apply new engine oil to all sliding and rotating surfaces.
• Replace all gaskets, O-rings and oil seals with new parts.

items: (a) Insert valves in the cylinder head valve guides. Make sure the valves are installed in the correct order.
(b) Install the valve spring seats and new seals.

content.description: Exploded view of cylinder head showing valve installation positions and assembly orientation

items: (c) Install springs and spring retainers on the valves.
(d) Using SST, compress the valve springs and place two keepers around the valve stem.

content.description: Illustration showing use of SST tool to compress valve springs and install keepers

items: (e) Tap the stem lightly to assure proper fit.

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing valve stem with keepers and spring assembly, with arrow indicating light tapping direction

content.text: Using a dial gauge, measure the camshaft thrust clearance.
If clearance is greater than maximum, replace the camshaft and/or camshaft housing.

content.description: Illustration showing dial gauge setup for measuring camshaft thrust clearance with camshaft and housing visible
